item.title: Baby sleepwear sold by Walmart and Target recalled due to choking risk: CPSC
item.description: The U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission is warning parents and caregivers that a baby sleepsuit sold through popular retailers, like Walmart, Target and Amazon, could be a choking risk to infants.

item.title: Russia gives Iran intel that could help country strike US military: reports
